title: EE60110: Advanced Digital Signal Processing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

(Digital Signal Processing (18615) is the prerequisite for the
subject)Statistical Signal Processing: Method of least squares (LS). Recursive
LS. Consistency of estimates. Observer, full and reduced order. Kalman filter.
Parameter estimation. Nonparametric Estimation: Correlation and spectral
analysis. Cepstrum.Yule-Walker equation. Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
Higher order statistics, triple correlation and bi-spectrum.Transform Method of
Signal Processing: Haar, Hadamard and Walsh transform. Wavelet transformation,
sub-band coding. Image analysis, compression. Adaptive Signal Processing: Voice
band signal, signature analysis, speech identification. Voice models. Lattice
structure. Echo cancellers. Equalizers. Multi-rate filters. QMF. Fuzzy Signals:
Signal description. Network implementation. Neuro-fuzzy processing of signals.
